title: Meet the Foundation Models framework
description: Learn how to tap into the on-device large language model behind Apple Intelligence! This high-level overview covers everything from guided generation for generating Swift data structures and streaming for responsive experiences, to tool calling for integrating data sources and sessions for context management. This session has no prerequisites.
